classical_node_name: medial septal / diagonal band of Broca glutamatergic neuron
search_note: Classical node soma is extrahippocampal (medial septum/diagonal band of Broca). The UBERON:0002421 fallback location caused the DB to search hippocampal/entorhinal regions — anatomically wrong. Correct candidates are in WMBv1 subclass 115 MS-SF Bsx Glut (CS20230722_SUBC_115), supertype 0518 MS-SF Bsx Glut_1 (CS20230722_SUPT_0518), and clusters CLUS_2054 through CLUS_2072 (19 clusters). These nodes have soma at Medial septal nucleus (MBA:564) and Diagonal band nucleus (MBA:596), matching the classical type.

correct_candidates.note: Correct atlas candidates found by direct taxonomy search. These are NOT in the DB candidate lists because the DB query searched the wrong region (hippocampal formation fallback). Candidates below are CANDIDATE status — full property comparison pending map-cell-type workflow.

subclass.name: 115 MS-SF Bsx Glut
subclass.rationale: Soma in medial septal nucleus (271 cells) and diagonal band nucleus (59 cells) — direct anatomical match to the classical MS-DBB node. Classified Glut by WMBv1. Neighborhood HY-EA-Glut-GABA is consistent with septal glutamatergic identity. Slc17a7/Slc17a6 not in the precomputed panel but the atlas Glut classification is genome-wide; Chat-negative and Gad1-low expected from marker list (no cholinergic or GABAergic markers listed). The precomputed panel shows Gad2=9.39 at the supertype level but this is an artefact of the hippocampus-focused marker panel applied to a non-hippocampal node — the atlas-wide Glut classification takes precedence. The MS-DBB classical node specifies Slc17a7+/Slc17a6+ (VGluT1/VGluT2), Chat−, Gad1−, which matches the expected profile for WMBv1 septal Glut neurons. Four electrophysiological subtypes of the classical node (fast-spiking, cluster-firing, burst-firing, slow-firing) likely distribute across the 19 clusters within this subclass.
subclass.confidence_signal: HIGH — direct anatomical concordance; only glutamatergic subclass with soma explicitly in medial septal nucleus + diagonal band nucleus in WMBv1

supertype.name: 0518 MS-SF Bsx Glut_1
supertype.rationale: Only supertype within the MS-SF Bsx Glut subclass. Soma distribution mirrors the subclass — medial septal nucleus dominant, diagonal band present. The defining markers (Bsx, Onecut1) are transcription factors expected in septal glutamatergic neurons, not hippocampal projection neurons. This is the correct rank-1 candidate for the ms_dbb_glutamatergic_neuron classical node. Note: it is the sole supertype for this subclass, so it represents the full diversity of the 19 underlying clusters including potential correlates of the four electrophysiological subtypes.
supertype.confidence_signal: HIGH — single supertype under the correct subclass; anatomy confirmed at Medial septal nucleus + Diagonal band nucleus

non_candidates_summary: All 30 DB-returned rank-0 clusters and all 20 DB-returned rank-1 supertypes are EXCLUDED. The root cause is that the DB query used UBERON:0002421 (hippocampal formation) as the soma location — a documented fallback because no UBERON term for the medial septum was entered at ingest time. This caused the search to return hippocampal and parahippocampal glutamatergic neurons: CA1-ProS clusters (0275, 0294), CA3 cluster (0301), CA2-FC-IG cluster (0401), NP SUB cluster (0481), L2/3-L6 IT entorhinal/parahippocampal cortex clusters (0122-0158, 0330-0341), EP-CLA clusters (0013-0015), and TPE-ENT cortical clusters (0023-0037). None have soma in the medial septum or diagonal band of Broca. The correct atlas counterpart is WMBv1 subclass 115 MS-SF Bsx Glut (CS20230722_SUBC_115, under class 13 CNU-HYa Glut), the sole glutamatergic subclass with documented soma in the medial septal nucleus (MBA:564, 271 cells) and diagonal band nucleus (MBA:596, 59 cells). It has one supertype (CS20230722_SUPT_0518, 0518 MS-SF Bsx Glut_1) and 19 clusters (CS20230722_CLUS_2054 through CLUS_2072), all labelled MS-SF Bsx Glut. The four electrophysiological subtypes of the classical node (fast-spiking, cluster-firing, burst-firing, slow-firing VGluT2+ cells) likely correspond to subsets of these 19 clusters. Recommendation: run map-cell-type workflow against CS20230722_SUBC_115 / CS20230722_SUPT_0518 with VGluT1/VGluT2, Chat-negative, Gad1-negative constraints.
